desc: The Mike-9 from Foxtrot Mike Products has high end features, out of the box, at a fantastic price. The heart of the Mike-9 is its proprietary bolt carrier and forward charging handle system. Foxtrot Mike designed the lightweight bolt carrier so that the Mike-9 can fire without the need for a buffer tube. The bolt carrier reciprocates on a unique dual nested recoil spring, which is completely retained inside the upper receiver.
